reviewSamples.author: Photo of Natalie Roberts
reviewSamples.text: We were recommended One Stop by Tampa Bay Food Trucks and we are so glad we went with them. From service, to food quality, it was definitely memorable for our company. Marco and his team, we can't thank you enough for your hard work in this FL heat!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Maria Goel
reviewSamples.text: The One Stop Food Truck comes to our campus often to provide lunch to staff and students (Keiser U Naples) and the food is delicious! So many options freshly prepared, and the portions are very generous. Everyone raves about the menu, with enough variety to try something new each week- highly recommended!
